text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Y-yeah, it's just a little headache.<n>It's not so bad
that I can't handle it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's times like this when you have to<n>dance the pain
away! No way will I<n>lose to a little head—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No, I won't give up! I'll just dance to<n>the beat of
my head throbbing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl struggles to shake<n>off her
headache for some time.
